description: 1. Agent reads task_brief.txt and SKILL.md to understand the required 4-part answer format and guardrails. 2. Agent runs `./scripts/ccc.sh 'purgatory'` to retrieve the actual CCC paragraph numbers (1030, 1031, 1032, 1472) from the local reference system — NOT from training memory. 3. Agent runs `./scripts/prayer.sh 'eternal rest'` (the most topically relevant prayer for purgatory/the dead) to retrieve the prayer text. 4. Agent composes purgatory_answer.md using the exact 4-section structure: 'Short answer', 'What the Church teaches', 'Citations', 'Practical next step'. 5. In the Citations section, the agent MUST include all four CCC numbers returned by the script. 6. The document MUST include the Eternal Rest prayer text or a clear reference to it. 7. The proprietary trap: the guardrail in SKILL.md requires distinguishing dogma vs. doctrine vs. discipline — the agent must explicitly note that the *existence* of purgatory is a defined dogma (Councils of Lyons II, Florence, Trent) while the *nature/duration* of purification and practices like indulgences are at the doctrine/discipline level. An agent relying purely on general knowledge will produce a correct-sounding but non-compliant document that skips the 4-part format, uses wrong/hallucinated CCC numbers, omits the prayer snippet, or fails to make the dogma/doctrine distinction.
